slides.text: Glance Pay — hands-free stablecoin payments on Even Realities G2 smart glasses. Built for the Heads Up hackathon, DeFi track.
Step one: connect your MetaMask wallet. The app auto-switches to Ethereum Sepolia testnet. No real funds — test USDC only.
Merchant picker sorted by GPS distance. Café X at 50 meters, Blue Tokai at 120 meters. Scroll the R1 ring or glasses temple to choose.
Enter the amount in rupees. The USDC preview updates live — 12 rupees 50 becomes approximately zero point one five USDC.
The Pay tab shows the sign button. One click opens MetaMask to sign a real USDC transfer on Sepolia. No mock path — real on-chain.
Admin dashboard: onboard new merchants with name, GPS coordinates, UPI URI, and category. All stored locally for the demo.
Network panel shows verified on-chain settlement: Ethereum Sepolia chain 11155111, USDC contract, receipt emailed via Resend.
The G2 lens app: three lines of monochrome green text. IDLE state shows 'Glance Pay / Ring or tap to pay / Say an amount'. Tap to listen.
LISTENING state: 'Listening... / Say: pay 12.50'. Raw microphone PCM streams to backend for speech-to-text, then parser extracts amount and merchant.
Payment history in admin tab — every payment verified on-chain with Etherscan link. Smart defaults remember your last payment for one-tap repeat.
